scope: Bounded public-source catalog of ten desktop/web readers and adjacent reading workflows. Four targeted implementation reviews: PDF.js, Okular, Sioyek and Zotero Reader. Detailed release evidence, comparisons, review ranges and proposal reasoning are in knowledge/alternatives-desktop-web.md.
limitations: Not exhaustive market coverage. No application, screen-reader, rendering-conformance, performance or synchronization tests were run in this lane.
Source pins usually identify development heads, not released binaries; release/version distinctions are recorded in the report.
GitHub REST requests reached a shared unauthenticated rate limit; subsequent evidence used raw source and public HTML. Issue searches were bounded.
One Zotero comparator expression was evaluated separately in JavaScript; that is not a Zotero application or full-method reproduction.
Licenses identify reviewed project declarations, not an exhaustive dependency-license audit. Unknown does not mean absent.
